turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Hi Nadia, thanks for taking my call. I wanted to walk you through the fund we discussed last time and see if it's something you'd like to move ahead with today.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Thanks, Ethan. Go ahead, I've got a few minutes.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: The TEST GBP Equity Fund is a diversified equity fund, holding a broad mix of listed companies across several industries. Dealing is straightforward — you can subscribe or redeem on any business day, and everything is handled electronically once you're set up. I recommend investing in this fund.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: There's no minimum holding period, and statements are issued monthly so you can keep track of the position. Subscriptions placed before the daily cut-off are processed the same business day.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: A number of our clients hold it alongside other positions in their portfolio, and the minimum for any top-up afterwards is quite low.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Before I can process anything, I'll need to confirm a couple of details on file. Could you give me your identification number?

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you. And your date of birth, please?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: My date of birth is 9 February 1988.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: That all matches what we have on file. Would you like to go ahead with the TEST GBP Equity Fund?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I'd like to buy the TEST GBP Equity Fund — please invest 25,000, in GBP.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Understood. I've noted your instruction to buy the TEST GBP Equity Fund for 25,000 in GBP. I'll get this processed today and send you the dealing confirmation once it's through.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thanks, Nadia — I'll be in touch once it's done. Have a good rest of your day.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Thanks, Ethan. You too, bye for now.
